caption:
2 OF 9 🎮🏀 We gave up Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick and 5 picks for Kawhi Leonard. He's played 2 of our 9 games.

• 2017-18 in San Antonio: quad injury, 9 games
• 2018-19 with us: 60 games and a title
• 2021-22: partial ACL tear, 0 games
• 2025-26: 65 games, a career-high 27.9 PPG
• Oct 27, 2026: swelling in his left knee

Will he play 60 games for us this season? 👇
